title: Five tips for a calmer morning

scenes.headline: Mornings don't have to feel like a sprint
scenes.narration: If your mornings feel like a race before eight o'clock, you are not alone. Here are five small changes that can make a real difference.

scenes.headline: Prep the night before
scenes.narration: Set out clothes, bags and breakfast dishes before bed. Tomorrow's decisions are already made, so the morning has fewer of them.

scenes.headline: Wake up fifteen minutes earlier
scenes.narration: A short buffer gives you room to breathe. Use it for stillness, not for scrolling.
scenes.body: Even a quiet cup of tea counts.

scenes.headline: Park your phone out of reach
scenes.narration: Leave it charging in another room. The first few minutes of your day belong to you, not to your inbox.

scenes.headline: Give everyone one job
scenes.narration: Kids can pick their own shoes, and a partner can handle the lunches. Shared tasks shrink the load for everyone.

scenes.headline: Leave room for one slow minute
scenes.narration: Sit down, stretch, or look out of the window for sixty seconds. It resets your mood before the day gets going.

scenes.headline: Pick one tip for tomorrow
scenes.narration: Start with the one that feels easiest. Calm mornings are built one small habit at a time.
